brief: Concatenate arrays, or values as strings
description: concat follows its first value. If it is an array, return a new array of the entries of every value in order; every value must be an array (write [...a, v] or push(a, v) to add a single value). Otherwise convert every value of any data type to string and return the concatenated result; a value with an undefined value is represented by 'undefined'.

parameters.description: Arrays to concatenate, or values to convert to strings and concatenate.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: A new array if the first value is an array, otherwise the concatenated string.
